Haseeb — the opening film

Ten seconds. Everyday business information arrives and competes for attention; one Haseeb-teal movement puts it in order; three statements; the mark; then it hands off to the page. This is the shipping code — the stylesheet block, the script module and the markup are copied into this file from the site itself. Skip is live from the first frame, and Esc skips too.
